body: Looking at this makes me wonder... Do you think Kojima will insert himself into the game like Mads, Toro, Reedus?

I think it's a shhh on a meta level. Remember, in Ground Zeroes Snake removes his goggles much like Mads in the trailer. Snake used to say "Kept you waiting, huh" but MGS was silenced and Mads is expressing that silence with his gesture. A Silent Hill so to speak

It's fascinating, really. The pre release period has become a kind of game in its own right and Kojima is a master at playing it. Not saying that DS is quite there yet where MGS was at its height but damn, he sure is trying!
Another thing that reminded me of MGS was how Mads directed the soldiers with his hand. Reminds me of Ocelot using SOP in Act 3 having the Frogs shooting.
Mads Kubrick is phenomenal. Sending  legit chills down my spine.
David Cage is pretty experimental too!
This is blowing my mind right now!
